items.title: Jack Kerrigan Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: it takes somebody like... uh... Edmond Sushant... or... John... Curran... John Curran... or... oh... what's her name... they're the ones... that... brought the jazz back

ctx.x: remember... if at any time... they... stopped... using it... at... at... at... at parties... and then... when... it started again... when... if people... stopped liking it... and stopped listening to it... then started again... you know... like... the death of jazz... and the revival... in the... early 40's... and so on... do you... remember anything? moved away from...

New Orleans... see... I went to Texas... to live... for five years... and... I just don't know... anything about... I know something's... about revival... but it takes somebody like... uh... Edmond Sushant... or... John... Curran... John Curran... or... oh... what's her name... they're the ones... that... brought the jazz back... and got everybody interested... in it... and stuff like that... I wasn't present... for that kind of stuff...
well... when they first started... having it... the Pest... was getting up...
